events.event: Communications and Digital Minister Meutya Hafid said YouTube and Meta platforms (Instagram, Threads) are high-risk for children and should not be used by them, and wants platforms to self-rate and display age limits like film ratings.
events.key_numbers: Example rating '17 tahun ke atas' · criticised the common 13+ practice · no deadline or sanction stated · said at Kosgoro discussion, Senayan, 26 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: Parents and kids: the government says the apps most Indonesian children use daily are not meant for them.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered same day by detik, Kompas, IDX Channel, Okezone, Kumparan, Suara, Medcom, iNews

events.event: Danantara presented more than 40 projects across six clusters at its Technology Innovation Investment Forum 2026, including a 1 GW data centre, AI chips with Arm, a national e-commerce platform, sovereign cloud and a national car and motorcycle project.
events.key_numbers: 40+ projects · 6 clusters · 1 GW data centre · 6 semiconductor sectors · Arm partnership to train 15,000 digital talents · no investment value given
events.why_it_matters: The state wealth fund is steering where public money goes in AI, chips and a national e-commerce platform.

events.event: Deputy Minister Nezar Patria said Komdigi is concerned about AI-made short-drama content on social media that funnels users to paid apps with pornography, sexual violence and online gambling, and is considering involving the Film Censorship Board (LSF).
events.key_numbers: No figures given · shared dashboard with platforms · unregistered OTT apps targeted
events.why_it_matters: The short dramas many people binge may be a doorway to gambling and porn apps.

events.event: Komdigi urged platforms to be transparent about algorithms, moderation and AI use after claims that karhutla content was restricted, repeating that it never asked for takedowns and saying Meta AI chatbot answers are not proof of government orders.
events.key_numbers: Moderation 'on content, not accounts' · Meta clarification requested (22-23 Oct) · 'trust but verify' for AI answers
events.why_it_matters: Whether the government or the platforms are hiding fire and haze posts affects what people can see and trust.

events.event: The Ministry of Manpower (Kemnaker) warned of scams using the 2026 Bantuan Subsidi Upah (BSU) name via fake links on WhatsApp and Instagram, saying the only official site is bsu.kemnaker.go.id.
events.key_numbers: 4 protective steps · no payout amount, loss or victim count given
events.why_it_matters: Workers expecting a wage subsidy are being targeted with phishing links that ask for personal data and OTPs.

events.event: Komdigi's CSIRT warned organisations to patch the critical PHP2Shell flaws, saying firewalls alone are not enough and that active exploitation has been reported.
events.key_numbers: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 · CVSS v4.0 9.2 each · nearly all PHP versions since 5.4 · fixed in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35 · patch released 21 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Many Indonesian sites run PHP; unpatched ones can be taken over without a login.

events.event: Japan's GMO Internet Group and Park24 said they will compensate customers after major data breaches, as a wave of attacks linked to the PHP flaw and AI-driven hacking hits Japanese firms.
events.key_numbers: GMO: 5,000 yen (~Rp577,000) per customer, shares -15% · Park24: 3,000 yen (~Rp346,000) per customer, loss up to 5.5 bn yen (~Rp634 bn) · 723 cyber incidents in Japan through 20 Oct 2026, above full-year 2024 and 2025
events.why_it_matters: Shows what a data breach costs a company and what customers get back.

events.event: Elon Musk said SpaceX signed a US$40 billion debt deal to buy Nvidia GPUs for its AI unit, and warned more than 200 AI cloud providers could fail or merge.
events.key_numbers: US$40 bn (~Rp724,460 T per CNBC) · chips due Q1-Q2 2027 · AI unit Q3 revenue US$7.56 bn vs US$813 M a year earlier (~9x) · 200+ AI cloud providers at risk
events.why_it_matters: Shows how much borrowed money is going into the AI chip race and the bubble worry behind it.
